publicNote: Learners reported missing answer wording. All options now stay beside their explanations in practice and mock review.
Learners had trouble finding nickname setup. You can now add an optional nickname during setup and change it in Settings.
Learners reported unreadable text after Coach me. It now highlights words within the question without overlapping text.
Learners expected a fresh start after resetting CISA. Confirmed resets now return to setup after saving, while other exams stay.
Learners could only find sharing options for backups. Android now offers a folder picker to save a backup on the device.
